top_signals.title: US Core PCE Rises 0.2%, Consumer Spending Soars in August
top_signals.summary: The personal consumption expenditures price index, the Federal Reserve’s preferred measure of inflation, increased 0.3% from a month earlier. Excluding food and energy, the PCE price index rose 0.2%. US consumer spending rose in August at the fastest pace in over a year, helping to power the economy through persistent inflation. Michael McKee reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Germany Moves Closer to Blocking Chinese Logistics Takeover
top_signals.summary: Germany is considering blocking a bid by Chinese container giant Cosco Shipping Holdings Co. from buying a majority stake in a small Hamburg-based freight company over security concerns.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
